text:
Alisa: Quick heads-up — vendor asked for a paired timeline for H200/MI300 SKU gating + marketplace listing. They want final compatibility matrix by Friday EOD. Who can own the matrix and the signoff path?
Matt: I can own the matrix draft. Will need eng-runtime to confirm driver/kernel deltas (esp. MI300). Can we get an ETA from Raj?
Raj: I’ll run the perf/compat tests in our staging rack. MI300 baseline by Thu morning, H200 by Thu evening. Need Suresh to confirm SI install window for validation run.
Suresh: OK I can schedule the SI validation Wed-Thu. Will need the exact image tags and kernel version. Can someone post the tags here?
Dina: Staging image tags:
```
redwood/runtime:0.9.3-mi300-rc1
redwood/runtime:0.9.3-h200-rc1
kernels: 5.10.128 + nvidia-535-driver-rc
```
Dina: Note — B200 partner wanted a separate compatibility row since power profiles differ. Add that into the matrix.
Alisa: Good call. Also vendor asked for a short "embargo handshake" note for press team — recommended announcement windows and fallback messaging if SKU slips. Draft in thread below.
Matt: Draft embargo handshake (very short):
- Pre-announce: 2 weeks before public listing, internal embargo to partners
- Partner handshake: 72h signoff on compat matrix and hotfix plan
- Public announce: 48h after successful canary on 5% dev traffic
Fallback: If compat or firmware blocks, delay public announce and release a targeted SI hotfix + docs.
Matt: Should we route canary to Dedicated capacity first and not Hosted? Safer for SLAs.
Raj: Yes — Dedicated pool first. I’ll create a routing rule: canary -> dedicated/us-west-2 -> fallback to hosted-low-prio if dedicated fails.
Suresh: For SI install: need a one-line runbook for partners. Sketch: "apply runtime tag, reboot nodes, run sanity check script: ./ci/check_gpu_health.sh --model mi300"
Dina: Adding the runbook step to matrix spreadsheet. Also adding a "driver rollback" entry and exact git hashes.
Alisa: Action items:
- Matt: matrix draft + embargo note (owner) — due Thu EOD
- Raj: staging perf/compat runs + routing rule (owner) — results Thu evening
- Suresh: SI validation window and partner runbook (owner) — Wed-Thu
- Dina: add runbook + driver hashes to matrix (owner) — Thu morning
Alisa: Ping ops-bot to register the embargo window and create an internal calendar invite. :calendar:
ops-bot: Created calendar event "HW Marketplace Embargo: H200/MI300" for Fri 09:00-10:00 PST, invited: Alisa, Matt, Dina, Raj, Suresh.
Matt: One extra ask from partner — can we include a small compatibility note for Gaudi (community image only) even though it’s out of scope for the GA? They want wording to show roadmap coverage.
Alisa: Fine to include a "roadmap note" row: coverage planned Q3, community image verified, full cert after GA. Keep wording non-committal.
Raj: Will add a quick perf note for Gaudi in the comments column.
Suresh: I’ll prepare the SI checklist and a short escalation path (who to call if FPGA/firmware issues show up).
Dina: Spreadsheet link (view only): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123-matrix — I’ll open edit to owners.
Alisa: Thanks team. If anything slips, call the abort: public announce blocked until partner signoff or we have a hotfix plan. :no_entry_sign:
Matt: I’ll post the final ETA in this thread when matrix is up.
Raj: I’ll upload test logs to the staging bucket when done -> gs://redwood-staging/gpu-compat/3781234567/
Suresh: Noted. Will confirm SI slots once Dina updates the spreadsheet.
Alisa: Closing loop — reminder to keep messaging short to press and partners. We want clarity not speculation.
Dina: Will do.
Matt: Thanks all :thumbsup:
